title: 8:14 sanctuary. Other inspired writers have identified the Lord as a sanctuary or temple (Ezek. 11:16; John 2:18-20; Rev. 21:22). In addition, Jesus Christ is both the temple's "chief corner stone" (Ps. 118:22; Eph. 2:20) and its "sure foundation" (Jacob 4:16; Hel. 5:12). The veil of the temple represents Christ's flesh (Heb. 9:3).
author: Tina M. Peterson
